alerts.extra: This job is {{extra}} above what the customer approved ({{approved}}). Ask for approval before doing more.
alerts.partsWaiting_one: One part ordered for this job has not arrived yet.
alerts.partsWaiting_other: {{count}} parts ordered for this job have not arrived yet.
alerts.partsLate_one: A part for this job is late.
alerts.partsLate_other: {{count}} parts for this job are late.
alerts.releaseWarn: {{message}}. You will be asked to confirm before handing it over.
alerts.releaseBlock: {{message}}. It cannot be handed over until it is paid.
alerts.storage: Left {{days}} days past the free days: storage fee {{fee}}.
alerts.carOut: {{car}} is out on loan to this customer.
alerts.extraClaim: This job is {{extra}} above what the payer authorised ({{approved}}). Wait for the payer, or record a decision to go ahead in the claim.

approval.additional: More work was found. Please see what is needed and approve or decline it.

parts.categoryHint: Prices the part from its cost with the category's markup.
parts.costHint: What you paid, before tax. Used with the category to price it.
parts.orderNumberHint: The order number from Purchasing, if you made one. The supplier and date follow it.
parts.keepOld: Keep the old part for the customer or assessor
parts.returnHint: {{name}}: {{qty}} on the job. What is returned goes back on the shelf; the rest stays on the job.

labour.taskHint: A standard job with a standard time. Leave empty to type hours.
labour.bookedHint: What the technician really worked. Blank for now is fine.

charges.title: Towing and other fees
charges.empty: No charges. Towing, a courtesy car or an agreed fee go here.

collect.odometerHint: Kept on the job and on the vehicle.

invoice.claim: This job has an insurer claim. The insurer and the customer are invoiced separately from what the insurer approved.
invoice.walkIn: This customer has no record yet. One is made from their name and phone when you invoice.
invoice.payNowHint: Choose how the customer pays and the invoice is paid in the same step.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.hint: A deposit is a payment on the customer's account. It shows on the invoice and counts toward being paid.

workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.hint: My jobs today, the bays, hours worked against billed, services coming due and courtesy cars.
workshop.signedByHint: Name of the person who left it and agreed to the condition noted.

bays.title: Bay
bays.noBaysHint: Add the bays, lifts and booths of the workshop in Job settings.
bays.loadFailed: The bay board could not be loaded
bays.settingsHint: The places a job is worked on: a bay, a lift, the paint booth. A bay holds one job at a time.

loan.title: Courtesy car
loan.hint: Lend one of your courtesy cars while theirs is here. Mark an item as a courtesy car when you add it.

photos.title: Photos and files
photos.requiredHint: Set by the kind of job. Take them before the stage shown.
photos.shareHint: Mark a photo as shareable to show it to the customer or insurer on their link. Staff-only photos are never shown there.
photos.kindsHint: The kinds your workshop takes. Tap one to stop using it.
photos.kindsDefault: Nothing added yet: the usual kinds (intake, damage, odometer, fuel ...) are offered.

claim.title: Insurer work
claim.noLines: No estimate sent to the payer yet. Make one from this job's parts and labour.
claim.nothingAuthorised: Nothing is authorised yet. Wait for the insurer before starting.
claim.signHint: Write down who accepted the finished work. The claim can then be invoiced.
claim.needRecord: Insurer jobs bill the customer's excess to a customer record. This walk-in has none yet.

receive.jobTypeHint: Brings the right checklist and the photos this kind of job needs.
receive.belongingsHint: List anything left inside, and note valuables taken out.
receive.walkInHint: A name and phone are enough. A customer record is made when you invoice.

work.emptyHint: Jobs you are in charge of appear here.
work.loadFailed: Your jobs could not be loaded

technicians.name: Technician
technicians.emptyHint: Hours appear when labour is put on jobs.
technicians.hint: Billed is what the customer pays for; worked is what the technician really spent. People without invoicing rights see only their own row.

due.emptyHint: Set the next service date on a job's Workshop tab and it appears here.

cars.emptyHint: Cars lent to customers appear here until they come back.

catalog.name: Name
catalog.examples: {{n}} standard times are examples. Check them against how long your workshop really takes, then they are yours.
catalog.workTypesHint: Mechanical, body, paint, electrical. Each can have its own hourly rate.
catalog.rateHint: Tax included, in {{currency}}. Blank: the shop's usual rate.
catalog.tasksHint: Standard jobs with a standard time (and a fixed price if you want). Pick one when adding labour.
catalog.noTasksHint: Add the jobs you do most often with how long they take.
catalog.hoursHint: How long the job takes by the book.
catalog.fixedPriceHint: Optional, in {{currency}}, tax included. Charged as one line whatever the hours.
catalog.categoriesHint: The markup on cost used when a part is priced from its cost. These percentages are examples: set yours.
catalog.markupHint: On top of cost, before tax.

types.title: Kinds of job
types.hint: A service, a body repair, an alteration: each brings its own checklist, warranty and the photos it needs.
types.emptyHint: Add a few so the right checklist and photos come with each job.
types.photosHint: Photos the job must have before it reaches a stage. What happens if they are missing is set in the rules.

rates.feesItemHint: Towing, storage and other charges are invoiced under this service item. Blank: the labour item.
rates.rulesHint: What happens when work goes beyond what was approved, an item leaves unpaid or photos are missing, and when customers are reminded.
rates.unapprovedWork: Work beyond what the customer approved
rates.unapprovedWorkHint: Warn: allowed with a note. Block: needs an additional-work approval first.
rates.releaseUnpaid: Handing over before it is paid
rates.releaseUnpaidHint: Customers on account terms are never stopped.
rates.requiredPhotos: Moving on without the required photos
rates.requiredPhotosHint: Warn: allowed with a note. Block: not allowed.
rates.storageGrace: Free days before storage is charged
rates.pickupReminder: Remind the customer to collect after (days)
rates.serviceReminders: Remind customers when their next service is due
rates.serviceDaysHint: Sent by the message channel you have set up, once per due date.

start.title: Getting started
start.hint: A few steps to make this workshop yours. They tick themselves when done.
start.none: No getting-started steps. Switch on an industry pack in Add-ons to get them.
start.loadFailed: The steps could not be loaded
start.sampleHint: Fill the workshop with a believable week of jobs to try things out, and take it away when you are done. Sample customers are named "Sample: ...".
start.sampleLoaded: Sample jobs are loaded. A sample job that was invoiced stays.

modeHint.order: The part is ordered from a supplier for this job. Stock is taken when it arrives.
modeHint.customer: The customer brought the part. It is listed on the job but not invoiced; only the work is.
